system_prompt:
You are taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in the fourth grade. Answer each question as well as you can.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
Several students were collecting information about how fast cars were driving by their school. The table below shows the results for 20 cars.

| Car | Slow | Medium | Fast |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | | X | |
| 2 | X | | |
| 3 | X | | |
| 4 | | | X |
| 5 | | | X |
| 6 | X | | |
| 7 | | X | |
| 8 | | X | |
| 9 | X | | |
| 10 | X | | |
| 11 | X | | |
| 12 | | X | |
| 13 | X | | |
| 14 | | | X |
| 15 | | | X |
| 16 | X | | |
| 17 | | X | |
| 18 | X | | |
| 19 | | X | |
| 20 | | | X |

To make the results easier to read, the students started to put the information into the bar graph.

Complete the bar graph.

[Image: Bar graph]

Figure, described in words:
An incomplete bar graph titled "Car Speed". The vertical axis is labeled "Number of Cars" with tick marks and numerical labels at 0, 5, and 10. The horizontal axis has tick marks dividing it into three category columns labeled "Slow", "Medium", and "Fast". A single light-gray shaded rectangular bar is drawn in the "Slow" column, reaching a height of approximately 9 (just below the tick mark for 10). The "Medium" and "Fast" columns are currently empty.

answer.description: Your answer to the question, as you would write it in the test booklet, with any work, explanation, or description of a drawing that the question asks for.
answer.title: Answer

output.answer: Count the X marks in each column. Slow: cars 2, 3, 6, 9, 10, 11, 13, 16, 18 = 9 cars (the existing Slow bar already reaches 9, so it is correct). Medium: cars 1, 7, 8, 12, 17, 19 = 6 cars. Fast: cars 4, 5, 14, 15, 20 = 5 cars. Complete the graph by drawing a bar in the Medium column rising to a height of 6 (one unit above the 5 tick mark, about halfway between 5 and 10), and draw a bar in the Fast column rising to a height of 5 (level with the 5 tick mark). Check: 9 + 6 + 5 = 20 cars in total.
